correctness.rationale: For every j, full no-singleton partition facets cannot occur in any boundary because they exhaust the ground set. Gottstein Theorem 5.3 supplies primitive cross-polytope cycles with one unique such facet and proves they form an integral basis, so the exposed-facet coordinate map is an integral S_n-isomorphism. Exact stabilizer orientation signs are sign of equal-size block permutation; rational quotient transfer and Frobenius reciprocity give the strict-partition formula. Standalone checks enumerate all faces and compare all conjugacy-type Lefschetz traces for 2<=n<=7.

value.rationale: The full all-degree integral S_n-module is a structural invariant substantially more informative than nonequivariant Betti ranks. It settles the natural automorphism action of a complex whose full automorphism group was already identified. The quotient rational homology is controlled by strict integer partitions and has the sharp threshold n>=j(j+3)/2, giving a new all-size orbit-space topology classification rather than a small numerical instance.
